What Do They Say About Us

Kiddo Playway is a Taxway Kiddo franchised school whose aim is to provide highly researched learning environment to little kids. We are initiating to recognize capabilities in your tiny tots and focusing on polishing those capabilities.

At Kiddo, we care your child like home and we provide a playful study environment that helps to kid inculcate learning in his own way. Here, 75 percent of curriculum is activity based and our innovative teaching methods add a crown to our curriculum.

We are at an aim of producing confident, creative and eager learners due to which we focus on recognizing the need of each individual kid and work on their overall development. Moreover, we do not forget the role parents as we organize Parenting Science Webinar by experts every month, which help parents to overcome problems that they face while handling their kid.

For a child’s development, it is important to have a good foundation

Every child is like a raw pitcher, which needs to be molded in a correct shape. A little child needs an environment where the child can get a foundation so that the child can develop physically, mentally and emotionally. We, Kiddo Playway, are in continuous efforts of providing the foundation you are looking for your child. We value childhood and without compromising the smile of children, we provide them learning so that they can enjoy what they learn. So, come and enroll your child in the environment where he or she will start to explore life in a unique way…
